body.name: \(\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY,com}}\)
body.construction:
Define
\[
 \mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY,com}}
 =\{(P_n)_{n\ge1}\in
 \mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY},0}\cap\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY,pub}}:
 \mathsf A_{R=0}((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{bal1}}((P_n))
 \wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{map}}((P_n))\}.
\]
Thus every member belongs both to the baseline event-transfer class \(\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY},0}\) and to \(\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY,pub}}\), has \(M^R=0\), has globally balanced rank-one factors, and satisfies the source-to-event mapping of all uniform block conditions.  This definition imposes no nonlinear-remainder lower bound.
